author: Satoshi (M04)
base: M07 campaign base (feature_names, window, horizons, target_feature_indices, evaluator_fixed) unchanged

budget.caps: 1.25 x measured peak per class at the pin, never lowered without measurement
budget.proposal: 16 configs x 2 seeds in the first DOIN batch, ordered by the DOIN proposer, capped by the candidate budget model (parameters, fused width, VRAM measured)

conditional.front_H_kalman_slot: RESERVED: engine key extra_channels (M01 f0a850c8) mapped to a conditional flat parameter (e.g. modular.extra_channels in {none, <H1 declared set>}) with its Kalman parameters active only when the operator is active; names and bounds come from H1's declaration, not invented here
conditional.model.target_residual: seasonal_naive_cumulative_6 = engine kind seasonal_naive_cumulative, period 6 (Y_h(t-6), M07-confirmed)

data: M07 eth4h_l24_h6_v1 (window 24 x 4h, horizons 1..6, target log_return_1, z_train units); split and naive rows exactly M07's
eligibility_and_closure: each cell's per-horizon table carries zero-return, train-mean (strict naive), persistence and seasonal-6 MAE on the same rows; a config is ELIGIBLE only if it beats zero-return at every horizon on every seed; literature NOT_AVAILABLE / NOT_COMPARABLE
label: DESIGN_NOT_A_RESULT
pin: a615c212 lineage (M07 runs 024ce260 = a615c212 + its cell variant); Kalman cells need M01 f0a850c8 or later, re-pinned through the identity-proof protocol

seeds.promotion: top-3 configs re-run at seeds 2023/2024 before any claim; incumbent = strict minimum of the paired mean over all seeds the config was enqueued with

trigger: launch the moment M07 reports an ELIGIBLE financial config: validation MAE beats the zero-return naive at EVERY horizon h1..h6 on the same rows, on every paired seed (M07 CLOSURE beats_zero_return all True)
validated: merged with M07 r0_v1 bounds, validate_space passes at e75c5414 or later (cumulative residual flat value)
